candidate.name: pydantic
candidate.summary: Upgrade after review. 13 upstream API breaking changes, no usage of the changed parts located in this repository — review before upgrading.

breaking.remediation: Behaviour changed: `parse_raw` is now deprecated. Review call sites for assumptions that no longer hold. Prefer making the assumption explicit over silently adapting to the new behaviour.

Behaviour changed: `__root__` no longer support the `arbitrary_types_allowed`. Review call sites for assumptions that no longer hold. Prefer making the assumption explicit over silently adapting to the new behaviour.
`GetterDict` was removed from `pydantic`. Replace every usage. Verify against the installed version's actual exports before choosing a replacement — the changelog may be incomplete.

breaking.summary: `pydantic.generics.GenericModel` no longer necessary, and has been removed
breaking.remediation: Behaviour changed: `pydantic.generics.GenericModel` no longer necessary, and has been removed. Review call sites for assumptions that no longer hold. Prefer making the assumption explicit over silently adapting to the new behaviour.

timeline.detail: pydantic 2.12.5 → 2.13.5 · review required · 13 breaking changes upstream; drift found no usage in this repository but could not prove none — verify before upgrading

runtimeAnalyses.statement: Upstream requires Python >=3.10; this repository declares Python 3.14 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 3.10 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 3.13 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 7.3.20 in .github/workflows/ci.yml, 3.14 in .github/workflows/codspeed.yml, 3.14 in .github/workflows/publish.yml, 3.15 in .github/workflows/tests-vcs-deps.yml, which satisfies it.

breaking.remediation: Minimum python version is now >=3.10. Update the runtime version declared in CI workflows, engine fields, and container images. Do not change application logic for this.
